# directus_collection (Resource)

Manages a Directus collection (its metadata and underlying database table).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collection` (String) Name of the collection (also the database table name). Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `fields` (Attributes List) Initial fields to create alongside the collection (POST /collections). Typically used to define the collection's primary key/ID field. Only applied at creation and never read back from Directus, so changing this forces a new resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `meta` (Attributes) Directus-managed presentation metadata (directus_collections). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--meta))
- `schema` (Attributes) Underlying database table info. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schema))

<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Required:

- `field` (String) Field (column) name, e.g. "id".
- `type` (String) Directus field type (e.g. integer, uuid, string).

Optional:

- `meta` (Attributes) Directus field metadata (directus_fields). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields--meta))
- `schema` (Attributes) Underlying database column definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields--schema))

<a id="nestedatt--fields--meta"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields.meta`

Optional:

- `display` (String) Display id used to render the field.
- `display_options` (String) Display-specific options as a JSON object.
- `group` (String) Field group this field is nested under.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the field is hidden in the app.
- `interface` (String) Interface id used to edit the field.
- `note` (String) Help note shown under the field.
- `options` (String) Interface-specific options as a JSON object.
- `readonly` (Boolean) Whether the field is read-only in the app.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the field is required in the app.
- `sort` (Number) Sort order of the field in the app.
- `special` (List of String) Special Directus behaviors (e.g. uuid, cast-json, m2o).
- `validation` (String) Validation filter rules as a JSON object.
- `validation_message` (String) Custom validation error message.
- `width` (String) Field width in the app form (half, full, ...).


<a id="nestedatt--fields--schema"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields.schema`

Optional:

- `comment` (String) Database-level column comment.
- `data_type` (String) Database column data type (e.g. integer, uuid, varchar).
- `default_value` (String) Column default value as JSON (string, number, bool, or null).
- `has_auto_increment` (Boolean) Whether the column auto-increments (auto-increment integer ID).
- `is_nullable` (Boolean) Whether the column allows NULL.
- `is_primary_key` (Boolean) Whether the column is the primary key.
- `is_unique` (Boolean) Whether the column has a unique constraint.
- `max_length` (Number) Maximum length for string columns.
- `numeric_precision` (Number) Numeric precision for numeric columns.
- `numeric_scale` (Number) Numeric scale for numeric columns.



<a id="nestedatt--meta"></a>
### Nested Schema for `meta`

Optional:

- `collapse` (String) Default collapse behavior in the app (open, closed, locked).
- `color` (String) Accent color (hex) shown in the app.
- `display_template` (String) Display template for item previews.
- `group` (String) Parent collection for nesting in the app.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the collection is hidden in the app.
- `icon` (String) Material icon name shown in the app.
- `note` (String) Description shown in the app.
- `preview_url` (String) URL template used to preview items (e.g. a live site URL).
- `singleton` (Boolean) Whether the collection is a singleton.
- `sort_field` (String) Field used for manual sorting.


<a id="nestedatt--schema"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schema`

Optional:

- `comment` (String) Database-level comment on the table.
- `schema` (String) Database schema the table belongs to.

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Table name (equals the collection name).
